Third-party libraries (MIT licence, Copyright 2010-2023 Three.js Authors, https://threejs.org)
- three.min.js            : Three.js r147 (WebGL 3D library), build/three.min.js from npm package "three@0.147.0"
- three-postprocessing.js : EffectComposer, RenderPass, ShaderPass, MaskPass, UnrealBloomPass, CopyShader and
                            LuminosityHighPassShader from the same package (examples/js/...), joined into one file.
They are loaded with normal <script> tags (no modules), so the game still works from file://.
